From 3eaf2da98993ecdf6e46a2b27cd31ef84a12e45f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Marek Szyprowski <m.szyprowski@samsung.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2020 07:47:59 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] phy: samsung: Merge Kconfig for Exynos5420 and Exynos5250

Exynos5420 variant of USB2 PHY is handled by the same code as the
Exynos5250 one. Introducing a separate Kconfig symbol for it was an
over-engineering, which turned out to cause build break for certain
configurations:

ERROR: modpost: "exynos5420_usb2_phy_config" [drivers/phy/samsung/phy-exynos-usb2.ko] undefined!

Fix this by removing PHY_EXYNOS5420_USB2 symbol and using
PHY_EXYNOS5250_USB2 also for Exynos5420 SoCs.

Reported-by: Markus Reichl <m.reichl@fivetechno.de>
Fixes: 81b534f7e9b2 ("phy: samsung: Add support for the Exynos5420 variant of the USB2 PHY")
Signed-off-by: Marek Szyprowski <m.szyprowski@samsung.com>
Acked-by: Krzysztof Kozlowski <krzk@kernel.org>
Reviewed-by: Jaehoon Chung <jh80.chung@samsung.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20201202064759.24300-1-m.szyprowski@samsung.com
Signed-off-by: Vinod Koul <vkoul@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/phy/samsung/Kconfig b/drivers/phy/samsung/Kconfig
index 0f51d3bf38cc..e20d2fcc9fe7 100644
--- a/drivers/phy/samsung/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/phy/samsung/Kconfig
@@ -64,12 +64,7 @@ config PHY_EXYNOS4X12_USB2
 config PHY_EXYNOS5250_USB2
 	bool
 	depends on PHY_SAMSUNG_USB2
-	default SOC_EXYNOS5250
-
-config PHY_EXYNOS5420_USB2
-	bool
-	depends on PHY_SAMSUNG_USB2
-	default SOC_EXYNOS5420
+	default SOC_EXYNOS5250 || SOC_EXYNOS5420
 
 config PHY_S5PV210_USB2
 	bool "Support for S5PV210"

diff --git a/drivers/phy/samsung/phy-samsung-usb2.c b/drivers/phy/samsung/phy-samsung-usb2.c
index 3908153f2ce5..ec2befabeea6 100644
--- a/drivers/phy/samsung/phy-samsung-usb2.c
+++ b/drivers/phy/samsung/phy-samsung-usb2.c
@@ -127,8 +127,6 @@ static const struct of_device_id samsung_usb2_phy_of_match[] = {
 		.compatible = "samsung,exynos5250-usb2-phy",
 		.data = &exynos5250_usb2_phy_config,
 	},
-#endif
-#ifdef CONFIG_PHY_EXYNOS5420_USB2
 	{
 		.compatible = "samsung,exynos5420-usb2-phy",
 		.data = &exynos5420_usb2_phy_config,
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **Kconfig (drivers/phy/samsung/Kconfig)**:
   - Removed the `PHY_EXYNOS5420_USB2` configuration symbol.
   - Updated the `PHY_EXYNOS5250_USB2` symbol to default to both `SOC_EXYNOS5250` and `SOC_EXYNOS5420`, allowing it to be used for Exynos5420 SoCs as well.

2. **phy-samsung-usb2.c (drivers/phy/samsung/phy-samsung-usb2.c)**:
   - Removed the conditional compilation block for `CONFIG_PHY_EXYNOS5420_USB2`, which was previously used to handle the Exynos5420 USB2 PHY configuration.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The changes in the Kconfig file directly relate to the modifications in the `phy-samsung-usb2.c` file. By removing the separate configuration for `PHY_EXYNOS5420_USB2`, the code that previously handled Exynos5420 USB2 PHYs is no longer needed, as the Exynos5250 configuration now encompasses both Exynos5250 and Exynos5420 SoCs. This consolidation simplifies the configuration and resolves the build issue caused by the undefined symbol for Exynos5420.

diff --git a/drivers/phy/samsung/Kconfig b/drivers/phy/samsung/Kconfig
index 0f51d3bf38cc..e20d2fcc9fe7 100644
--- a/drivers/phy/samsung/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/phy/samsung/Kconfig
@@ -64,12 +64,7 @@ config PHY_EXYNOS4X12_USB2
 config PHY_EXYNOS5250_USB2
 	bool
 	depends on PHY_SAMSUNG_USB2
-	default SOC_EXYNOS5250
-
-config PHY_EXYNOS5420_USB2
-	bool
-	depends on PHY_SAMSUNG_USB2
-	default SOC_EXYNOS5420
+	default SOC_EXYNOS5250 || SOC_EXYNOS5420
 
 config PHY_S5PV210_USB2
 	bool "Support for S5PV210"

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/phy/samsung/phy-samsung-usb2.c`**
   - Removed the conditional compilation block for `CONFIG_PHY_EXYNOS5420_USB2`.
   - The entry for the Exynos5420 USB2 PHY in the `samsung_usb2_phy_of_match` array has been removed, which means that the code now only references the Exynos5250 configuration.

2. **File: `drivers/phy/samsung/Kconfig`**
   - The `PHY_EXYNOS5420_USB2` configuration symbol has been removed entirely.
   - The `PHY_EXYNOS5250_USB2` configuration symbol has been modified to allow it to be selected for both Exynos5250 and Exynos5420 SoCs by changing its default condition to `SOC_EXYNOS5250 || SOC_EXYNOS5420`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The changes in `phy-samsung-usb2.c` and `Kconfig` are directly related as they both address the handling of the Exynos5420 USB2 PHY. By removing the separate configuration symbol for Exynos5420 in `Kconfig`, the code in `phy-samsung-usb2.c` is simplified to only use the Exynos5250 configuration. This consolidation resolves the build issue that arose from having a separate configuration for Exynos5420, which was causing undefined references during the build process. The modifications ensure that both Exynos5250 and Exynos5420 use the same code path, thereby streamlining the driver and preventing build errors.
